basics.name: Abel Casas García
basics.label: Backend Engineer · Software Architecture & Applied AI
basics.summary: Backend Engineer specialized in Java and Spring Boot, with experience on business-critical, high-availability platforms. I design scalable, decoupled systems using Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, and SOLID principles, and integrate LLMs and AI agents to automate and speed up the development lifecycle.

work.name: idealista
work.summary: Development and evolution of distributed backend services and business-critical, high-availability integrations, with technical leadership in AI-driven process automation.
highlights: Design and build scalable, decoupled backend microservices and event-driven architectures.
Integrate LLMs and AI agents into the development workflow for code generation, debugging, process analysis, and technical documentation.
Drive the adoption of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) to improve predictability and shorten time-to-market.
Optimize service performance and data access on Oracle databases.
Apply Clean Code, SOLID, Hexagonal Architecture, and automated testing to keep systems stable.

work.name: RIU Hotels & Resorts
work.summary: Evolution and maintenance of the CORE transactional platform, critical to the hotel group's global operations.
highlights: Refactored and optimized critical CORE modules, improving performance and reliability.
Identified and removed bottlenecks in internal applications, streamlining data flows.
Resolved complex production incidents, ensuring high availability and business continuity.

work.name: Intricom Resources
work.summary: Development of the internal CORE product to automate workflows and speed up the setup of new projects.
highlights: Designed and built the product's transactional core with .NET/C#, NestJS, and Docker, keeping modules loosely coupled.
Built a generic, modular architecture that significantly reduced setup time for new projects.
Ensured platform scalability through containerization and efficient persistence patterns.
